name: SiteSuperCharger
author: AnAdminer

sections.description:
SiteSuperCharger helps your website look as attractive as possible to search engines helping you to acheive the highest search engine rankings.

Contact Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to get started!
sections.installation:
Install SiteSuperCharger via the plugin directory, or by uploading the files manually to your server. After activating SiteSuperCharger, you’ll need to enter your GUID at Settings -> SiteSuperCharger

For info about acquiring a GUID for SiteSuperCharger visit https://www.mheroes.com.
sections.faq:
Is SiteSuperCharger free?

You must purchase Search Engine Optimization services from Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to use SiteSuperCharger
sections.changelog:
5.5.5

Release date: Apr 19th, 2026

  • Security (important): closes seven additional hardening items flagged by a follow-up security audit. Includes: email-header injection prevention on the schedule-inspection form (blocks spam-relay abuse), removal of an unauthenticated front-end code path that could delete landing pages, stricter redirect validation on the SSC Redirects feature, additional JSON encoding safety on structured-data output, stored-XSS escaping on auto-generated sitemap child lists, and authorization + rate-limiting on internal admin AJAX and async endpoints. No user action required. Details in the v5.5.5 audit bundle.

5.5.4

Release date: Apr 19th, 2026

  • Improved: plugin inventory now flags compatibility issues in addition to age. New badges: “untested w/ current WP” (plugin’s wp.org tested_up_to is 2+ major versions behind your site’s WordPress), “requires newer PHP” (plugin needs a PHP version higher than your server has), “requires newer WP” (plugin needs a WordPress version higher than installed). Catches “works but unmaintained” risk that the age-band alone misses.

5.5.3

Release date: Apr 19th, 2026

  • New: tiered check-in cadence. Client sites ping the SSC app every 5 minutes (uptime SLA). Property/landing sites every 15 minutes. Legacy sites once per day. Check-ins are staggered across the fleet so they don’t all fire at the same second.
  • New: heartbeat payload now includes a site health snapshot (PHP/WP versions, OPcache status, active plugin count, unpushed audit events, health-score grade) so the SSC app can build fleet dashboards without polling each site.
  • New: plugin inventory pushes to the SSC app once per 24 hours as part of the heartbeat, so fleet-wide outdated-plugin alerts work without visiting each site.

5.5.2

Release date: Apr 19th, 2026

  • New: Plugin Inventory & Security Audit panel. Lists every installed plugin with current version, latest wp.org version, last-updated date on wp.org, and days since that update. Color-codes by age: green (fresh, <6 months), yellow (aging, 6–12 months), orange (old, 1–2 years), red (abandoned, 2+ years). One-click update per plugin. Same “outdated plugin” security signal Wordfence charges for — now built in.

5.5.1

Release date: Apr 19th, 2026

  • New: SSC Health Score panel on the settings page. Single at-a-glance view of every subsystem (schema output, security, audit log, trust badges, OPcache, forms). Each check is color-coded green / yellow / red with a one-line explanation, and the panel gives you a letter grade A-F. No new data collection — pulls everything from existing settings and transients.

5.5.0

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Security (important): removes a shared auth key that was previously baked into the plugin source and therefore readable by anyone who downloaded the plugin from wordpress.org. Every install now generates its own 64-character random key automatically on activation (and lazily on first use if you upgraded without re-activating). No action needed on your side. Old installs continue to function — their local copy of the key just stops being used.
  • Security (important): plugin no longer accepts raw HTML / JavaScript from the remote tracking channel. Previously the SiteSuperCharger backend could push arbitrary custom_head_scripts / custom_footer_scripts into your site’s <head> and <footer>. Only validated tracking IDs (Facebook Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager) are now accepted from the remote source. If you had custom head/footer HTML configured server-side it will stop applying — re-enter it under Settings → SiteSuperCharger → Advanced → Tracking where it’s gated on your site administrator’s unfiltered_html capability.

Covers audit findings P0-10 (supply-chain mass-XSS via tracking channel) and P0-11 (world-readable shared auth key shipped on wp.org). Full details in the security audit issued 2026-04-18.

5.4.41

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Improved: anti-spam on the schedule-inspection form. Added signed form-age check (bots that submit in under 3 seconds get rejected), content-pattern detection (URLs in name field, non-English characters in English-only fields, excessive capitalization, known spam keywords). Rate limit tightened from 10/hour to 5/hour per IP. Real customers see no change; spam drops substantially.

5.4.40

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Fix: v5.4.39 was too conservative about emitting LocalBusiness on non-SSC pages — sites with empty business identity config were losing LocalBusiness entirely even when no theme was emitting it. Now we emit as long as there is a business name.

5.4.39

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: SpeakableSpecification schema for voice search. Marks your h1 and first paragraph as content Google Assistant / Alexa should read aloud.
  • New: VideoObject auto-detection. Embedded YouTube, Vimeo, and Wistia videos get structured data automatically so they appear in Google Video search.
  • Improved: smarter LocalBusiness emission on non-SSC pages. If your theme or SEO plugin already emits a rich LocalBusiness, and your SSC config is sparse, we skip duplicate emission to avoid confusing search engines.

5.4.38

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: business schema on every public page, not just landing pages. Your LocalBusiness, trust badges, and ClaimReview entries now emit on your home page, about, contact, and any hand-authored page — alongside your SEO plugin’s existing schema, not replacing it. Toggle under Schema Output settings if you need to disable.

5.4.37

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: ClaimReview / fact-check schema. Publish rebuttals to false or misleading reviews; Google displays your response alongside the original claim in search results. Emitted as schema.org ClaimReview entities with proper Claim + reviewRating structure.

5.4.36

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: Trust Badges / Certifications setting. Enter your BBB accreditation, manufacturer certifications, industry memberships, etc. and they appear in your site’s structured data as EducationalOccupationalCredential entities, with LocalBusiness.hasCredential references. Also includes a [ssc_badges] shortcode to display a badge strip in the footer or a widget.

5.4.35

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Fix: AI Crawler Policy now works on sites that have a static /robots.txt file. Previously the policy was only honored by the WP virtual robots.txt — if the webroot had a static file (common on managed hosts), our rules were silently ignored. Now we wrap the managed rules between sentinel markers inside the static file, preserving all other content.

5.4.34

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: AI Crawler Policy setting. Choose from 5 presets (Allow all / Allow citation AI only / Block AI training / Block all AI / Custom) to control which AI crawlers can access your site. Covers ~18 known AI bots. Default is “Allow citation-based AI only” — you appear in AI answers with attribution but your content isn’t harvested for training.

5.4.33

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: built-in Structured Data Validator in plugin settings. Enter any URL on your site, click Validate — checks every JSON-LD block for schema.org required fields, proper @id references, rating value ranges, FAQ answer length, breadcrumb sequencing, and more. Zero rate limits and works on staging sites.

5.4.32

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: live diagnostic log viewer in plugin settings. Shows the last 100 lines of the plugin log and PHP errors, auto-refreshing every 5 seconds. Lets you debug issues from the admin panel without server access.

5.4.31

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Hardening — closes remaining XML-RPC system methods (including pingback) that the v5.4.29 filter left accessible.

5.4.30

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Internal cleanup — clearer, more consistent wording in log messages and admin labels.
  • No functional changes.

5.4.29

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • New: site security monitoring — logs failed login attempts, admin logins, and suspicious requests.
  • XML-RPC disabled by default (major attack vector; almost no sites use it).
  • Login rate-limiting — slows brute-force attacks.
  • Blocks common user enumeration patterns.
  • Cleaner server fingerprint — removes info headers that expose WordPress details.

5.4.28

Release date: Apr 18th, 2026

  • Faster page loads — non-critical JavaScript now defers until the page is interactive.
  • New: sticky Call + Text buttons at the bottom of mobile screens for quick contact.
  • Booking form submissions now fire conversion events for analytics + ad retargeting.
  • Service pages with step-by-step content automatically get HowTo schema.
  • New: phone-number consistency check — admin warned if a page shows mismatched phone numbers.

5.4.27

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

  • New: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — AI assistants connect to the site as a first-class tool.
  • New: Availability endpoint so AI agents can suggest inspection dates directly.
  • New: OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json for programmatic API discovery.
  • Booking FAQ answers now marked speakable for voice assistants.

5.4.26

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

  • New: AI-agent-ready booking flow. AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) can now understand and schedule inspections directly through your site.
  • New: /schedule-inspection/ page with online booking form (auto-created).
  • New: Booking-intent FAQ block on every landing page with rich schema.
  • New: /.well-known/agent.json published for AI discovery.
  • Forms auto-enhanced with proper autocomplete + accessibility.
  • HTML sitemap respects the hide-from-sitemap flag on pages.
  • Faster page loads — hero image preload + lazy loading on other images.
  • /llms.txt endpoint helps AI search engines cite your site accurately.
  • Real user performance monitoring for Core Web Vitals.
